DOC-0002 Risk Management Summary — NeuroPulse Stimulator

draft

Risk Management Summary

This summary shows the identified risks and the requirements of the amplitude control function in one list, in author-assigned order, so a reviewer reads each risk beside the requirements written around it. One query block selects both types (Requirements Spec §4a). Each type is shown through a named presentation template chosen for this document (Section 7): requirements as checklist lines, risks as summaries. DOC-0001 shows the same requirements in full.

Risks and requirements

☑ REQ-0001 Closed-loop amplitude adjustment approved · verified by VER-0001

RSK-0001 Uncontrolled stimulation amplitude increase

Overall risk rating 15 · residual risk unacceptable · in_review

Hazard.

Loss of closed-loop feedback signal integrity

Controlled by REQ-0002, DES-0001

☑ REQ-0002 Single-fault amplitude ceiling approved · verified by VER-0002
☐ REQ-0003 Amplitude ceiling — subsystem allocation draft · not yet verified

Requirements that control a risk are listed on the risk as mitigated by, for example RSK-0001 is mitigated by REQ-0002.
